channel.title: Merkle Street
channel.description: Merkle Street reports crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, layer 2s, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation, security incidents and protocol upgrades.

item.title: Armada II shareholders approve Evernorth’s XRP merger
item.description: Armada II shareholders approved its Evernorth merger, advancing a deal that expects to leave the combined company with 473 million XRP and a Nasdaq listing.

item.title: Set an Avalanche Swap Deadline That Gives You Time to Act
item.description: An Avalanche swap deadline gives a pending transaction a time limit. Set it to allow normal confirmation delays without leaving stale trades open too long.

item.title: Find the Swap Behind a Token’s Daily High
item.description: A daily high is one recorded price point, often set by a single pool swap; trace its candle, pair and transaction before treating it as broad demand.

item.title: Reconcile BNB Chain Payouts from Transaction Logs
item.description: Match each expected payout to its on-chain transfer, then check the receipt, token contract and raw amount to find missing, duplicate or mismatched payments.

item.title: Why Large TRON Swaps Move the Price
item.description: A large TRON token trade moves along pool reserves, so routing, price impact and slippage shape the final amount a wallet receives and the fee it pays.

item.title: Why Polygon Bridge Deposits Can Take Time to Credit
item.description: A Polygon Bridge deposit can credit late because Ethereum confirmation, Polygon’s state-sync relay and wallet display update in separate steps; trace each stage before retrying.

item.title: Fast Bridge Withdrawal or Standard Exit? Follow the Liquidity
item.description: Fast bridge withdrawals trade a fee for immediate liquidity; standard exits wait for the bridge’s settlement path and suit transfers that can tolerate delay.

item.title: ETH on Mantle Needs MNT for the Next Transaction
item.description: ETH can sit on Mantle without MNT, but sending it, swapping it or using an app usually requires MNT for transaction fees; the bridge and wallet handle separate steps.

item.title: A Swap Can Reach the Wallet and Still Miss Your Account
item.description: A swap can reach the right wallet and still miss your account if its payout needs a memo. Check the network, address and tag before you send.

item.title: Tether-backed Utexo plans USDT return to Bitcoin in October
item.description: Tether-backed Utexo plans to issue USDT through Bitcoin’s RGB protocol this month, restoring the token to its first network while keeping most transfer data off-chain.

item.title: What a Connected Wallet Does While a Swap App Quotes
item.description: A connected wallet supplies the account and network while a swap app checks routes and prices; the quote is read-only, and a later trade still needs approval.

item.title: SEC proposes new crypto custody routes for advisers and funds
item.description: The SEC proposed crypto custody rules for advisers and funds, allowing limited self-custody and state trust company custody under safeguards open to comment.

item.title: How Solana fee tiers shape treasury swap routes
item.description: A treasury swap’s cost combines pool fee tiers, route quality, price impact and Solana transaction fees; the best route is the one with the strongest net output.

item.title: Setting Slippage for a BNB Token Swap
item.description: Slippage is the gap between a swap’s quoted and minimum accepted output; set it to cover ordinary price movement without accepting a poor fill.

item.title: SEC proposes conditional crypto self-custody for advisers and funds
item.description: The SEC proposed custody rules that could let advisers and funds use state trust companies or hold crypto themselves under safeguards, widening options.

item.title: Polygon Bridge moves tokens across two chains, with a return cost
item.description: A Polygon transfer locks or releases tokens through contracts on two chains; the return trip adds a burn, a checkpoint wait and a separate Ethereum gas bill.

item.title: How to choose a Byreal pool: depth, volume and fees
item.description: Byreal pool choice depends on how much price impact your trade causes, whether volume is sustained, and how fees change the cost of each swap.

item.title: How to Fix a Pending BSC Token Swap
item.description: A pending BSC swap often waits on its transaction nonce or fee. Check its status first, then replace it carefully or diagnose a mined failure before retrying.

item.title: Why TVM Opcode Costs Matter to Frequent TRON Users
item.description: TVM opcode costs shape Energy use on TRON contract calls, but each bill reflects the full contract path. Learn what drives it and how to check before sending.

item.title: Three checks before sizing Energy for repeat USDT transfers
item.description: Size repeat USDT transfers by checking the recipient’s token balance, simulating each call, and comparing total demand with Energy available across recovery.
